quote: general unrest and sleeplessness
note: No single-ingredient text; sleeplessness appears only on multi-ingredient homeopathic labels with no attribution to arsenite, so it cannot be credited to DRUG's own component.

quote: QSYMIA is a combination of phentermine, a sympathomimetic amine anorectic, and topiramate, indicated in combination with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity to reduce excess body weight
note: Combination-only, but topiramate is an active weight-loss component of Qsymia, so the overweight indication is attributable to it.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, temporal arteritis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Polymyositis is listed on single-ingredient hydrocortisone labels.

quote: Insulin Degludec is indicated to improve glycemic control in patients 1 year of age and older with diabetes mellitus.
note: Single-ingredient label covers diabetes mellitus generally, of which type 1 is a subtype (Xultophy combo is type 2 only).

quote: Macitentan tablets are an endothelin receptor antagonist (ERA) indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension
note: PAH is on the single-ingredient and EMA labels.

quote: Irbesartan tablets, USP are indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.
note: Hypertension is on the single-ingredient label.

quote: psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis (selected cases may require low dose maintenance therapy); ankylosing spondylitis
note: Single-ingredient label lists seronegative arthritides (psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis); not combination-derived, though the match is parent-to-child rather than exact.

quote: seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis; asthma; contact dermatitis
note: Cough variant asthma is a subtype of asthma, which is on the single-ingredient prednisone label.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchoconstriction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis is named on the single-ingredient formoterol label.

quote: Ciprofloxacin tablets are indicated in adult patients for treatment of typhoid fever (enteric fever)caused by Salmonella typhi.
note: Typhoid fever is on the single-ingredient label.

quote: Allergic corneal marginal ulcers
note: Corneal (marginal) ulcers are listed under ophthalmic diseases on single-ingredient prednisolone labels.

quote: seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis; asthma; contact dermatitis; atopic dermatitis
note: Contact dermatitis is on the single-ingredient prednisone label.

quote: Chlordiazepoxide and amitriptyline hydrochloride tablets are indicated for the treatment of patients with moderate to severe depression associated with moderate to severe anxiety.
note: Single-ingredient chlordiazepoxide is for anxiety/alcohol withdrawal only; the depression indication comes from the amitriptyline component.

quote: For relief of mild to moderate pain
note: Neither single nor combination text mentions bladder pain/cystitis; the edge rests only on generic minor/mild-to-moderate pain, not a combination artifact.

quote: INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess, and liver abscess
note: Intra-abdominal abscess is on the single-ingredient metronidazole label.

quote: Urinary Tract Infections caused by sensitive strains of E. coli and Proteus mirabilis
note: Single-ingredient ampicillin covers UTIs, of which recurrent UTI is a subtype.

quote: As replacement therapy in primary (thyroidal), secondary (pituitary), and tertiary (hypothalamic) congenital or acquired hypothyroidism
note: Primary hypothyroidism is explicitly on the single-ingredient label.

quote: Olmesartan medoxomil tablets, USP are indicated for the treatment of hypertension
note: Single-ingredient label covers hypertension, of which the secondary/endocrine form is a subtype.

quote: Ocular corticosteroids are indicated in inflammatory conditions of the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva, cornea, and anterior segment of the globe
note: Single-ingredient neomycin has no eye/iritis indication; the anti-inflammatory iritis/anterior uveitis use belongs to the hydrocortisone component of the ophthalmic combination.

quote: temporarily reduces fever
note: Fever reduction is on single-ingredient naproxen OTC labels.

quote: for the treatment of adult patients with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma
note: Ovarian cancer is on the single-ingredient pembrolizumab label; stage III is a more specific subset.

quote: a combination of sumatriptan, a serotonin (5-HT) 1b/1d receptor agonist (triptan), and naproxen sodium, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, indicated for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura
note: Combination-only, but naproxen is a co-active analgesic component of the migraine combination (sumatriptan/naproxen), so the indication is attributable to it in part.

quote: Treatment of schizophrenia.
note: Single-ingredient olanzapine is indicated for schizophrenia, of which simple schizophrenia is a subtype.

quote: PREMPRO/PREMPHASE is an estrogen plus progestin indicated in a woman with a uterus for
note: Postmenopausal osteoporosis prevention appears only on the conjugated estrogens/MPA label and is due to the estrogen; MPA is there to protect the endometrium.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin
note: Diphtheria is on single-ingredient erythromycin labels.

quote: AVYCAZ (ceftazidime and avibactam) is indicated for the treatment of complicated urinary tract in
note: Avibactam is never marketed alone; as the beta-lactamase inhibitor it is integral to the combination's antibacterial purpose, so cUTI is attributable to it.

quote: Diclofenac potassium for oral solution is indicated for the acute treatment of migraine attacks with or without aura
note: Migraine without aura is on the single-ingredient diclofenac label.

quote: simvastatin tablets USP are indicated to: Reduce the risk of non-fatal myocardial infarction and stroke.
note: Stroke risk reduction is on the single-ingredient simvastatin label.

quote: It may also be used topically and subconjunctivally in the treatment of infections of the eye caused by susceptible strains of Ps. aeruginosa
note: Eye infections are on the single-ingredient polymyxin B label.

quote: Such infections encompass conjunctivitis, keratitis and keratoconjunctivitis, blepharitis and blepharoconjunctivitis.
note: Combination-only, but gramicidin is one of the antibacterial components of neomycin/polymyxin B/gramicidin, so bacterial blepharitis is attributable to its own action.

quote: Temporarily relieves minor aches, pains and fever associated with: headache
note: Guaifenesin is an expectorant; headache relief on cold/flu combinations comes from the acetaminophen/analgesic co-ingredients.

quote: Telmisartan tablets, USP are an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) indicated for: Treatment of hypertension
note: Hypertension is on single-ingredient telmisartan and EMA labels.

quote: Severe essential hypertension when the drug cannot be given orally or when there is an urgent need to lower blood pressure.
note: Single-ingredient hydralazine covers severe essential hypertension, encompassing malignant essential hypertension.

quote: For treatment of primary dysmenorrhea
note: Primary dysmenorrhea is on the single-ingredient diclofenac label.

quote: Empiric therapy for febrile neutropenic patients.
note: Febrile neutropenia is on the single-ingredient cefepime label.

quote: Citrobacter freundii
note: Citrobacter freundii is a listed susceptible organism on the single-ingredient ciprofloxacin label.

quote: backache
note: Single-ingredient caffeine is for apnea of prematurity/alertness; backache relief on combinations comes from analgesic co-ingredients (aspirin/acetaminophen/orphenadrine), caffeine being only an adjuvant.

quote: Prophylaxis of Nasal Symptoms of Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis
note: Seasonal allergic rhinitis is on the single-ingredient mometasone label.

quote: reducing the frequency and severity of serious infections associated with Chronic Granulomatous Disease (CGD)
note: CGD is on the single-ingredient Actimmune label.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets, USP are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Neither single nor combination text supports chronic widespread pain (labels cover minor/acute pain only); the edge rests on generic pain, not a combination artifact.

quote: treatment of secondary amenorrhea and abnormal uterine bleeding due to hormonal imbalance
note: Single-ingredient MPA covers abnormal uterine bleeding, which encompasses menorrhagia.
